name: Yashiro
source:
[i]"I don't remember anything that happened before I met you, Milady. So to sum it up... you're all I have."[/i]

A well-mannered man who's slightly hard to read. He lost his memories, and was taken in by the heroine when he was in trouble.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
